# HAVIT — The Duolingo for Healthier Living

> AI-powered metabolic wellness app. Personalized coaching from metabolic-science diagnosis through gamified challenges and 24/7 adaptive guidance, in 35 languages. Published by Havit Inc.

HAVIT digitalizes premium metabolic health: care that previously required expensive equipment, specialist clinics, and dedicated coordinators is now accessible to anyone with a smartphone. The product takes a user from baseline diagnosis (body composition, metabolic markers, lifestyle), through a science-derived prescription tailored to their goal, into daily coaching that adapts to logs, progress, and feedback. The aihavit.com site is the public landing/marketing surface; the operative product lives in the HAVIT app (iOS / Android).

## Sections of This Site

- [Home — How It Works](https://www.aihavit.com/#how): the 4-step metabolic flow (diagnosis → prescription → coaching → change)
- [Features](https://www.aihavit.com/#features): coaching, article library, food scan, challenges
- [Validation](https://www.aihavit.com/#proof): open-beta trial data (n=596), peer-reviewed citations
- [About Havit Inc.](https://www.aihavit.com): the company behind HAVIT
